***AI GRG***

***Issues and Improvements***

Summary:

Here are some notes on AI GRG for ATAK 5.4 . I used the Samsung S23, S20 and Note 8 for testing. I used the same imagery as Cliff did with 5.6, GOOGLEHYBRID. There are a couple of things I had found that I wasn’t able to recreate Ill list them first. 

* **Impact: low**

* **`01/v5.4:`**Improvement/Issue (could not re-create): AI GRG asks if you want to load AI GRG when its already in use.

![][image1]

* **Impact: low**

* **`02/v5.4:`**Improvement/Issue (could not re-create):   AI GRG resizes Grid to 2 or 3 grid squares. 

![][image2]

![][image3]

* **Impact: medium \- duplicate labels create risk, requires operator to delete map data and re-start flow**  
* **`03/v5.4:`**Improvement/Issue: After re-opening GRG duplicate numbers are seen  
  * TEST STEPS  
    * Create GRG  
    * Run Detection  
    * Save and Close  
    * Create another GRG at another location.   
    * Re-open previous GRG  
    * Note duplicate 002, 003, and 004 labels 


  ![][image4]


  


  


  


  

* **Impact: medium \- operators will expect the same level of accuracy no matter how they run detection. Check with devs if this is expected (at one point we had better accuracy with sections drawn/smaller sections)**  
* **`04/v5.4:`**Improvement/Issue: When using Section Building detection software seems to be inconsistent.   
  * TEST STEPS  
    * Create GRG in populated are  
    * Run Building Detection, note X amount of buildings found  
    * Create Section (Section B) over X number of buildings that were previously detected  
    * Run Detection   
    * First Detection came back with 26 buildings found. However only 7 were previously detected (and only 7 are visible)   
    * Second detection states 1 building was found  
    * Create next section (Section C) note that its more consistent in the buildings it found. 


  ![][image5]

  ![][image6]![][image7]


  

* **Impact: Low**  
* **Recreated \- this is standard TAK label/marker behavior at various zoom levels**  
* **`05/v5.4:`**Improvement/Issue: Detected buildings not all visible when they possibly could be  
  * TEST STEPS  
    * OPEN AI GRG  
    * Navigate to residential area (10D FG 14861 15586\)  
    * Center in the Residential Area  
    * Create GRID  
    * Adjust to desired rows, columns and spacing (8 rows, 9 columns, 20 M)   
    * Run Detections  
    * Note: 46 Buildings Detected, however do not appear unless zoomed in 004, 007, 014, 015, 019, 020,022, 023, 027, 029,030,032, 033, 035, 036, 045\.   
    * Summary: Building detection prompt states 46 buildings detected, user must be zoomed in to have some numbers populate, this may be to due to having multiple numbers in a small space.  There are some numbers that are not in a congested space that don’t appear unless zoomed in.  
        
        
        
        
* **Impact: high \- affects number order inside grid**  
* **`06/v5.4:`**Improvement/Issue: buildings outside of Grid  
  * TEST STEPS  
    * OPEN AI GRG  
    * Navigate to residential area (10D FG 14861 15586\)  
    * Center in the Residential Area  
    * Create GRID  
    * Adjust to desired rows, columns and spacing (8 rows, 9 columns, 20 M)   
    * Run Detections  
    * Save Grid  
    * Close AI GRG  
    * Open previously saved Grid  
    * Note: There are multiple buildings outside of Grid. 

    ![][image8]

* **Impact: low \- intended current plugin behavior, would be a feature add/adjustment to improve accuracy of center point**  
* **`07/v5.4:`**Improvement/Issue: Center Point adjusts 20-50 meters depending on selected grid spacing  
  * Settings  
    * Center Point on 10 Meters spacing  
    * Center Point (Red \+ Sign) moves 43 m SW at 40 Meters When spacing is adjusted. Each time User increases spacing the center point moves 20-50 meters   
    * Recommend keeping the same center point and having the grid adjust off that point. 

    ![][image9] 

    

    ![][image10]![][image11]

    

    

    

    

* **Impact: medium \- operators will expect save/load functionality to work as intended, can cause time lost in mission prep if they don’t**  
* **`08/v5.4:`**Improvement: If you save the same GRG twice and try to open the most recent one GRID does not load.  
  * This may not be an issue for most, however is someone accidentally saves the current GRG, then re-saves it as a different name and attempts to load the last one saved the GRID will not populate.   
    * Test Steps  
      * Create a GRG  
      * Save GRG  
      * Re-save same GRG as new name  
      * Close GRG  
      * Attempt to load newest saved GRG  
      * Grid will not populate 

**OTHERS**

* **`09/v5.4`**`(others):`Improvement: folder files are saved to inside ATAK are Labeled “GR8”, recommend naming them AI GRG.  
    
* **`10/v5.4`**`(others):`Improvement: Using the “X” closes tool bar and not AIGRG.    
    
* **`11/v5.4`**`(others):`Improvement: When using GOOGLEHYBRID imagery building detection will select non-buildings such as driveways, vehicle trailers, piles of wood etc.  
  ![][image12]

  **Future Notes:**

	  
\-Check into the section labeling between different section types.   
\-Section building detection does not label all the buildings with the new section designation
